$comment: The Kubo (IPFS) binaries and offline WebUI bundled with the app. scripts/download-kubo.cjs verifies the binaries from s3://6529bucket/ipfs-binaries/kubo-v<version>/ and the official WebUI release archive. Binary archives matched their published .sha512; the WebUI SHA-256 is the official GitHub release asset digest. Restoring an older binary version does not undo an IPFS repository migration.
